_readme: Filings whose information table is another filer's book (a filing agent's slip), checked against EDGAR by hand. The row keeps its EDGAR numbers but is marked `misfiled` in universe.json (api/_lib/misfiledBooks.js): left out of every size ranking and listing, of the stock totals and of the headline total, and its page says whose table it is. `acc` limits the entry to that one filing: a later, correct filing clears it. `declared` is the filer's own cover-page total (Form 13F Information Table Value Total), in dollars.

filers.reason: The 2026-06-30 information table is Charles Schwab Investment Management's (3,439 identical lines, $751.32B); Sixth Street's own cover page declares $579.2M.

The 2026-06-30 filing is Kingsbury Capital Investment Advisors' book (121 of 121 lines identical to Kingsbury's own 2026-06-30 filing 0001104659-26-100644, cover total $118,195,925 identical too, so KMT's own Q2 total is unknown). Corrected 2026-10-22: the earlier entry had the direction backwards. Kingsbury's Q1 (113 lines, $106.4M) -> Q2 -> Q3 (0001104659-26-117244, 107 lines, $106.0M) is one continuous book (Illinois Tool Works 53,440 -> 53,011 -> 50,943 sh; Intensity Therapeutics 38,054 -> 496,493 -> 706,523; Offerpad 0 -> 303,595 -> 724,649), while KMT's own 2025-09-30, 2025-12-31 and 2026-03-31 tables hold 16-17 lines and ~$185M with none of those names. Same filing agent (0001104659) for both; Kingsbury (Wilmette IL, CRD 145658) and KMT (Hermosa Beach CA, CRD 328911) are unrelated advisers.

The 2026-09-30 information table is Tempo Wealth's (245 of 245 lines identical, the same 92,566-byte file, $820.71M = Tempo's own cover total); Schear's own cover page declares 81 lines and $294.70M. Both filed 2026-10-14. Schear's earlier filings match their covers (2026-06-30: 83 lines, $299.00M).
